verdict.rationale: Docs describe a single install path ('Install OpenClaw, run onboarding, and chat... in about 5 minutes'), with Docker explicitly optional and one-line desktop installers (Windows signed installer, macOS/Linux apps) as alternatives, plus a CLI-based flow for the Gateway. This matches the self-host-install story closely, though missing for 10: the exact literal install command/script text, and any independent/hands-on report confirming the 5-minute claim.
